text:
sarah-cs: Mistral week0 snapshot — quick sync. Hit three blockers that are blocking private deployment cutover: KMS key policy missing our role, their VPC only allows public egress (no internal CIDR whitelisting for our proxies), and audit logs aren't arriving in Splunk. Need triage and owners ASAP.

mike-netops: On the gateway side I pulled their SGs — they only have 0.0.0.0/0 outbound on 443/80. We need 10.100.0.0/16 whitelisted for our egress proxy + 10.100.1.0/24 for health-checks. Also their NAT is ephemeral; ask for a static jump NAT IP. @jules-engr can you confirm exact health-check ports?

jules-engr: Health checks are TCP 8080 and TCP 9090 (internal). For Splunk ingestion we need outbound TCP 9997. If they're still using syslog via UDP we need 514 too but confirm. Jump host is required for initial cutover to run ad-hoc probes.

sarah-cs: Noted. @rachel-customer can you paste the Splunk endpoint and whether it's TCP-only HF or syslog? Also please confirm jump host NAT IP.

rachel-customer: splunk-prod.mistral:9997 — it's a Heavy Forwarder, TCP only. We can open 9997. Jump NAT IP (temporary): 203.0.113.42.

alice-kms: Quick KMS update: their key policy omitted the Redwood service role ARN, which caused our rotation/decrypt tests to return AccessDenied (kms:Decrypt). We need to add the redwood role principal with Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey. I'll draft minimal snippet to avoid over-granting.

alice-kms: Snippet for their apply:```json
{ "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::555666777:role/redwood-infer-role" }, "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"], "Resource": "*" }
```

jules-engr: That looks good. If they apply that policy we should re-run integration tests. Also note: ensure key rotation is on and their account has CloudTrail for kms:Decrypt events forwarded to the audit bucket.

mike-netops: One more infra note: VPC Flow Logs are not enabled. Ask them to create an S3 bucket with prefix redwood-audit and a cross-account PutObject role/policy. We need the bucket ARN and to confirm PutObject permission for our audit role.

rachel-customer: Creating bucket now. Name: mistral-redwood-audit-prod. Will send ARN + confirm IAM role by EOD.

sarah-cs: Two follow-ups: 1) If KMS policy patch + SG changes happen today we can schedule a controlled canary tomorrow. 2) Renewal risk: CSM flagged that this delay is putting their timeline at risk — if we don't cutover in 7 days they may request a commercial review. Marking this P1 for CS ops and escalating to renewal owner.

sarah-cs: Action items — mike -> confirm SG rules applied and NAT mapping; alice -> send policy PR and test plan; jules -> schedule canary and rollback steps; rachel -> send Splunk ARN, jump host confirmation, and audit bucket ARN. I'll update the renewal tracker and loop in finance if needed.

mike-netops: :thumbsup: I'll coordinate with infra. If they provide the jump host IP we can add NAT rules + security groups and healthcheck allowlist in ~2h.

deploy-bot: deploy-preview:privnet-canary-v1 succeeded in staging. Quick note: canary run shows KMS decrypt succeeds when policy present. CI link: https://ci.redwood/infer/1234

rachel-customer: Policy applied and bucket created. Bucket ARN: arn:aws:s3:::mistral-redwood-audit-prod. Sending account ID and role names over DM.

sarah-cs: Great — closing the loop. Jules, can you confirm canary window tomorrow 10:00-11:00 PST? I'll post a calendar invite and a brief runbook for on-call.

jules-engr: Confirmed. I'll run the canary and monitor logs, will post to #eng-oncall and revert if any KPM or latency regression >10%. Revert plan uses the deploy flag --rollback-to=staging.

sarah-cs: Perfect. I'll capture these notes in the onboarding tracker and flag renewal owner. If anything slips I'll escalate. :lock:
